description: Mainnet accounts, programs and transactions dumped for the program tests (ARCHITECTURE §1.2, §8.2). Each entry records how it was fetched; SHA256SUMS pins the bytes (CI: cd tests/fixtures && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS). The Raydium entries (groups raydium_programs and raydium_state) are written by scripts/dump-fixtures.py; `snapshots` records the slot and RPC of each group.

accounts.name: pyth_sol_usd_shard0
accounts.description: Pyth sponsored shard-0 SOL/USD PriceUpdateV2 (ARCH §4.7, R-VEN §5, V7), the account crank_sol_usd reads.
accounts.slot_command: solana slot --url https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com (451037803 immediately before and after the dump)

files.accounts/pyth_sol_usd_shard0.bin: the account data: base64 -d of account.data[0] of the JSON (134 bytes)

accounts.name: raydium_amm_v4_program
accounts.purpose: the raydium_amm_v4 program account (upgradeable loader; names its ProgramData). tests/litesvm/src/fork.rs deploys the ELF at the mainnet address with it

accounts.name: raydium_amm_v4_program_data
accounts.purpose: raydium_amm_v4 ProgramData: the deployed ELF (T-RAY-*) and the header the venue-upgrade latch reads (T-LATCH on the dumped ProgramData, ARCH §8.2, §9 M3). Stored as header ‖ ELF; the account is header ‖ ELF ‖ zeros up to `space`, whose sha256 is `sha256` (fork.rs rebuilds and checks it)

snapshots.method: getAccountInfo (base64) of each program and ProgramData account; `solana program dump -um <program> out.so` gives the same ELF bytes followed by the zero padding
one getMultipleAccounts call (base64) over every account below, so all of them are the mainnet state at `slot`; the CPMM configs were listed first with getProgramAccounts(CPMM, dataSize 236)
